docs.dcterms_abstract: '… I suppose you are acquainted with the vacancy of a parliament man for Lichfeild. there be severall competitors but it is the opinion of a great many that if your brother Ashmole would declare himself positively either by himselfe or empower yourselfe or some other to appeare for him in time he might easily carry it for there is none that hath so generally the affection of the towne as I have reason to beleive…. I had this intimation from his friends yesterday. it is true Sir Harry Littleton stands. but being a stranger to this side of the country all the rest of the gentry of the County think themselves neglected. Sir Theophilus Biddolph stands for his [son ?] but that is thought for 2 in one family to engrosse a whole towne. so that your brother hath a fayre game to play if he will stir. for which you may be pleased to encourage if you think fit which I leave to your prudence.'

docs.dcterms_abstract: A letter written by Aphra Behn sent to her handler Mr Halsall. At the end of the letter, Behn also references the inadequacies of this cipher and her wishes to use her own.

In the meantime she asks for more money to sustain her while she awaits Scot.
